Coram : K.S. RADHAKRISHNAN, DIPAK MISRA
Uttar Pradesh Zamindari Abolition and Land Reforms C Act, 1951 - ss. 210 and 331(4) - Suit by respondent-plaintiff for their declaration as Bhumidhars being in adverse possession of the land - Suit dismissed on the ground that plaintiff could not obtain Bhumidhar person, as the land belonged to a tribe - Appeal against the o order also dismissed - Second appeals u/s. 331(4) before Board of Revenue - Board allowed appeals and decreed the suit holding that plaintiffs perfected their title uls. 210 by continuous possession for 20 years - Writ petition
Decision Date : 12-09-2012 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 6479/2012 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
